about_the_game:
《Merry Fishing Meow》— A Relaxing & Adorable Cat Fishing Adventure!

Welcome to Merry Fishing Meow! This is a charming and laid-back fishing game where you play as an adorable cat, available in either realistic or cartoon styles. Cast your line, unwind, and enjoy a purr-fectly delightful experience!

🌙 Day & Night Cycle
The game has a day-night system, offering different vibes—whether it's the calm daylight or the serene, starry night. Every moment feels immersive!

🎣 Fish, Sell, and Earn
Each round has a clear gold target. Catch fish to automatically sell them for coins—but watch out for pesky seagulls! They might swoop in and snatch your hard-earned catch!

🌟 Rare Fish & Big Rewards
Occasionally, ultra-valuable rare fish appear. Can you reel them in for a huge payout? Luck and skill will decide!

🛍️ Mystery Shop with Random Goods
After each round, visit the shop to buy randomized items with varying stats and rarities. You can even spend coins to refresh the shop—but budget wisely! Overspending might risk your next round’s goal.

🙏 Free Prayers for Blessings
Your cat can perform a prayer for free with graceful pose, receiving random buffs. Who knows? A little divine help might be just what you need!

Dive into Merry Fishing Meow—a cozy, cute, and relaxing fishing game where every cast brings joy!
